confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Porto price levels; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; summer accommodation rates (hostel, 1-star, 3-star) are least certain. EUR prices were brought to USD at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from their usual multiples of the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. The fx observation came from search summaries citing rba.gov.au; the RBA page could not be opened directly, and a follow-up search could not reproduce the 15 October figure (the RBA table it could read covered only 18-20 March 2026), so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Portugal and southern European mid-sized tourist-city price levels, placed somewhat below Lisbon; general knowledge only, no live listings consulted.
